'''Mei''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Her father was [[Sukarr]] of the [[Jensaarai/Legends|Jensaarai]] cult.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Let go, Mei. This won't end well. For either of us."<br />"You still don't understand. Revenge is something an unfeeling Jedi can never understand. Because it means loving another.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Mei|<ref name="Lone Wolf" />}}
Mei was the daughter of [[Sukarr]], a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Duel on Susevfi|slain]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] shortly before the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Later, Mei encountered another Dark Jedi, a [[Bpfasshi/Legends|Bpfasshi]] named [[Fomadu]], who was contemplating suicide in the wake of his brother [[Zukao]]'s [[Death/Legends|death]] during the [[Bpfassh Uprising]]. She saved Fomadu from killing himself, and he transferred the [[Force-bond]] he had shared with his Bpfasshi sibling to her. In return, Fomadu gave her purpose, while their new master, a mysterious [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Unidentified cyborg master|cyborg]], gave them hope. Mei, Fomadu and their master worshipped the [[Chaos|Great Void]], which, they believed, was the only truth, as there was no the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side]] nor the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light side]].<ref name="Lone Wolf" />

Shortly after the beginning of the [[Great Jedi Purge]], Fomadu and Mei tracked down two Jedi Masters, [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]] and [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]], to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], to kill them for their role in slaughtering the Bpfasshi. However, they found Obi-Wan Kenobi there instead, who went to Nar Shaddaa after his [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|duel]] with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to sell the [[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']] before travelling to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with newborn [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. They sensed Kenobi in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] when he was fighting with street thugs, and they helped the Jedi to defeat them, only to attack him themselves immediately thereafter. They chased the Jedi through the streets of Nar Shaddaa using the [[Force speed/Legends|Force speed]]. Fomadu finally caught up with Kenobi in the waste shaft, but the Jedi managed to strike his opponent down in a fierce [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]].<ref name="Lone Wolf" />

Mei arrived at the scene shortly thereafter, and she vomited upon noticing her lover's [[Sai cha/Legends|severed]] head. Kenobi justified his actions by telling Mei that Fomadu had left him with no choice, although his words didn't weaken her resolve to kill the Jedi. However, at Kenobi's insistence, she promised that she would deliver Luke to Tatooine should she emerge victorious. Kenobi foresaw that the duel would result in the death of both of them, and he refused to fight Mei, throwing his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to the ground. Unwilling to murder her defenseless opponent, Mei angrily demanded that he fight. When Kenobi refused to do so, Mei tried another approach by stealing the cradleboard with Luke. However, her attempt to use Luke as a bait for Kenobi failed when the baby used the Force to activate his father's [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] lying in the cradle. The lightsaber's blade struck Mei just behind her chin and erupted from the apex of her skull, killing the Dark Jedi.<ref name="Lone Wolf" />
